title: Good Night
summary: The background music that plays in Zombie 4: Darkness when the map turns to night and the zombies grow stronger.
description: The Zombie 4: Darkness wiki page lists among its trivia that the background music 'Good Night' plays when the map darkens - the moment humans lose their daytime advantage and the Night Stalker class is chosen. It is the mode's signature audio cue for the day/night switch. Composer, duration and file were not exposed by the page digest.
_confidence: high (title and usage stated on the Zombie 4: Darkness page)
